page.overview:
Who is Hayseed Turnip Truck?

Hayseed Turnip Truck is a male Earth pony in the Apple family who first appears in Sweet and Elite.

Hayseed Turnip Truck is an Earth pony with a beige-colored coat, dark yellow freckles, a two-tone brown mane and tail, brown eyes, and a cutie mark of three turnips. He also has a prominent overbite and wears a dirty shirt and green trucker's cap with a turnip on the front.

His name comes from the slang term "hayseed", another term for a bumpkin or generally unsophisticated person, and the idiom "fell off the turnip truck", meaning someone who is gullible or naïve.

Hayseed Turnip Truck appears again in Ponyville in the first shot of Sleepless in Ponyville when Scootaloo races through town on her scooter. He also attends the Apple family reunion in Apple Family Reunion; he takes part in the barn raising during Raise This Barn and is part of the Apple family photo.
